descriptions.value: The Royal MCP  WordPress plugin before 1.5.10 does not perform object-level or post-type authorisation checks in one of its search tools, allowing authenticated users such as a subscriber to disclose the title and content of non-public entries, including personal data stored by a companion Royal MCP  WordPress plugin before 1.5.10.

assertions.title: Royal MCP 1.4.38 - 1.5.9 - Subscriber+ Non-Public Post Disclosure via wp_search Ability
